book.name: Yoan
book.title: Xoulek Nimza wei Yoan byex o

content: Xel wong Yesu la bei xel a tuw e lek xax pepeeng
Woyom Pailat qou Yesu me la bei xel sesa e.
Xel vevek viy yis qapangek lekti me buwexe nambei qelumking me toung lek e lu. De xel byex teimb ding wei mateyek o ti lek e
de xel lam wou e lumama me neil embei, “Bendiyeing king wei Yudayeiw o!” Dom xel petapexe e ling.
Pailat loumelam myayaing no me neil wou xel Yudayeiw wei di qekuma yo bei, “Wei, a qou e me na loum myayaing bei xam ghe boulek bei a se xeiwou qayeeng qes ti lek e bei a bo qayeeng en e.”
Om Yesu lam myayaing is qelumking wei qapangek ying wei xel toung lek e lu me teimb ding wei mateyek o de Pailat neil wou xel bei, “Tambiy tiyo inye!”

Ka xel lumuki leitata me xel xe beyeiv yei moxo, eno xel taxe la bei, “Tuw e lek xax pepeeng! Tuw e lek xax pepeeng!” Ekom Pailat neil elox wou xel bei, “Xam venaxow qou e me tuw lek xax pepeeng, en ay eno a se xeiwou qayeeng qes ti bei a bo qayeeng en e.”
Lei ngandoung wei Yudayeiw neil elox bei, “Xe xe petieing ti, me petieing tiyon neil embei e mey, en emaxow neil embei e Anutu Neu Moux.”
Pailat ngo tine, eno moxo yaleeng ngandoung mouyo,
de moxo lox lalei eivek xomek seyap. Me teling wou Yesu, “Wang lam anghei inya?” Ekom Yesu se neil lulti wou e.
Pailat neil, “Wambei se baluk wou ay? Wa seng woulek bei a xe nikanzek teyei bei bo wang na myayaing o na tuw wang lek xax pepeeng?”
Yesu neil elox bei, “Wa se xe nikanzek ti ghanaw ay, wangwei Anutu se bong wou wang anghei gheyapu nei. Nambei nyon om tambiy tiwei qou a me lam wou wang ne eno wo sewokeing ghanaw wang veil.”

Woyom Pailat di wong me yei en embei bo Yesu na myayaing, ekom xel lei ngandoung wei Yudayeiw eno taxe la bei, “Wangwei wang bong tambiy tine na ond wa se gweleeng wei Sisa yo. Tambiy ti embei neimbei emaxow king ond wo vevek wou Sisa.”
Pailat ngo tine, eno moxo qou Yesu me la myayaing me deilek sia wei tambiy wei mi ngo qayeeng o nanghei beyeeng wei xel mi neil qakous zek o. Eivek Hibru vyend eno xel mi neil Gabata.
Inye bouk wei Menyexeing lulul lek Sounda tiwei Pasova yo, inyon nambei seivma evlek. Pailat neil wou xel Yudayeiw, “Inye xam xe king.”

Ekom xel taxe la bei, “Qou e me la veil! Qou e me la veil! De tuw e lek xax pepeeng!” Pailat teling, “Teyei bei a tuw xam xe king lek xax pepeeng?” Xel lumuki leitata lewexe bei, “Xa se xe king ti qe Sisa venaxow.”
Om Pailat wong e la wou xel bei xel atuw e lek xax pepeeng. Xel tuw Yesu lek xax pepeeng Om xel vevek qou Yesu me la.
De emaxow qalei e xe xax pepeeng me xel la beyeeng tiwei xel mi taxe lukanzek o. Eivek Hibru vyend eno xel mi taxe bei Golgata.
Nanghei inyon eno xel tuw e lek xax pepeeng is luw yayuw, nge wou valu de nge wou valu de Yesu eivek senghoing.
Pailat byex qayeeng ti me tuw lek xax pepeeng, qayeeng tine neil ambei nye: YESU WEI NASARET O, KING WEI YUDAYEIW O.
Yudayeiw ngenong pyaw dee tiyon, en beyeeng wei xel tuw Yesu lek xax pepeeng on toundei paviy beyeeng ngandoung, dee tiyon xel byex eivek Hibru vyend, me Rom me Grik.
De xel lumuki leitata wei Yudayeiw eno neil elox wou Pailat, “Wa se byex bei ‘King wei Yudayeiw o ti,’ qe tambiy tine neil embei, ‘A king wei Yudayeiw o.’”
Pailat lewexe bei, “Vati wei a byex, eno e toumendei nambei a byex woy.”
Xel vevek tuw Yesu lek xax pepeeng woy, eno xel qou e xe teimb dalus me dembu e la qendu vey, ti wou xel titi, is teimb ding wei xel duw en qaeing tixemou nanghei kwa me e la vaxa yo.
Xel neil wouma bei, “Xey ambei se zex teimb tine qe xey ambei banex qakous dee me na ghei bei eti tyek na qou.” Tiyon la teyei lek xoulek wei di yeip eivek qapiya wei neil embei,

content.text: “Xel dembu a xe teimb wouma eivek xel venaxow senghoing
de xel nex qakous dee en a xe teimb ding.” Qapiya Lalo 22:18

content: Om inye vati wei xel vevek wong o.
Paviy Yesu xe xax pepeeng eno ta me ta li vex toukale, me Maria wei Klopas venei me Maria wei Makdala yo.
Gyeik ingwei Yesu yei ta nanghei inyon me betiyeing tiwei e lalei vind o toukale paviyeing, eno Moxo neil wou ta, “Vex wei, wa neum moux inyon,”
woyom neil wou betiyeing tiyon bei, “Wei, vex tiyon wa tam.” Lek bouk kayon me e mi la, eno betiyeing tiyon qou vexo me la e maxow beeng.
Yesu xe meyeing
Kalekom Yesu woulek bei lulul dalus la wou eivek en kandek xoulek wei di yeip eivek qapiya eno bo neing lek, de Yesu neil embei, “A kwang tip.”
Deng wain senyeing ti toundei inyei, om xel toung balam eivek wain me e pup, dom tup lek xax hisop mema de zeim e lek la wou Yesu mya.
Yesu num wain ma, eno neil embei, “Moxo ma yo.” De ivma eivek dom wong nulaweeng la.

Bouk tiyon inye bouk wei Menyexeing wou lulul o, de yanyeing eno inye bouk ngandoung wei Sabat o. Om xel lei ngandoung wei Yudayeiw embei xel neing se toungami lek xax pepeeng lek bouk wei Sabat o, om xel teling wou Pailat bei xel na pyaw xel vaxend apek de zewax xel neing veil.
Om xel vevek la pyaw tambiy nge myaxeeng wei tumilek xax pepeeng wou Yesu byek o vaxa pek. De woyom xel la pyaw nge wei tumi wou e byek valu yo.
Ekom gyeik ingwei xel lam wou Yesu eno xel yei bei mey woy, om xel se pyaw e vaxa luw xouing.
Ekom xel vevek ti beum Yesu byek en yiy, de lutika eno gyand aluw memiing lam.
De tambiy tiwei yeimalek eno neil qayeeng en, me e xe qayeeng on wo neing. Moxo woulek bei neil zonghek. Om neilteyei en kandek xam ghe bongis ambei nyon.
Lulul ti beimambei yon la teyei lek en kandek xoulek wei di yeip eivek qapiya yo bo neing lek:

content.text: “Tyek xel se pyaw e kanzek ti pek.” Qouloum 12:46; Pyamema wou 9:12; Qapiya Lalo 34:20

content: De qayeeng nge neil ambei nye,

content.text: “Tyek xel mendi gyei tambiy tiwei xel beum o.” Sakarias 12:10

content: Xel ev Yesu

Kalekom Yosep wei Arimatia yo la teling wou Pailat en Yesu neing. Yosep on Yesu xe betiyeing ti, ekom mindei xupekeing en nambei yaleeng en xel lei ngandoung wei Yudayeiw. Pailat lewexe lek e om la qou Yesu neing me la.
Nikodimas, tambiy tiwei takwei eno la wou Yesu eivek boukeing eno la is Yosep me qou wel xeimangou wei xel maleeng xax mer me aloes myalouk lekti yo me lam. Nimaying teyei lek xoumeeng yal (30) kilo.
Tambiy yuw on qou Yesu neing me pelei wel wei xeimangou yo lek de beliv eivek qaeing teleing teyei lek Yudayeiw xe kwa wei xel mi ev xel meyeing o.
Eivek beyeeng wei xel tuw Yesu lek xax pepeeng nanghei yon eno xuk ti toundei inyon, de eivek xuk tiyon eno leiveeng meyeing vako ti toundei, xel seng ghei liw xelti eivek.
En inyon nambei Yudayeiw xe bouk wei menyexeing lulul o de nambei leiveeng meyeing tiyon toundei paviy, om luw lak liw Yesu eivek nanghei inyon.
